title: NEWCOMERS START HERE
description: NEWCOMERS START HERE — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Liza Beth

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Staying in Dew Valley, trade your ticket to advance in the help queue.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Liza Beth

Repeatable: No

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Staying in Dew Valley, trade your ticket to advance in the help queue.

Offer:

W3lcOMe TO d3W V4LL3Y! 1 AM TH3 HELpER noob0$@ur 45$I9neD.... Oops! Sorry about that...I forget that not everyone can speak Noobonese. I'll start again.

Welcome to Dew Valley! I'm your Helper Noobosaur. As with all newcomers, you will need to work your way through the nearby help queue in order to be assisted by the Ministry of Human Resources. Dungeon Runners will be assisted in order by help queue ticket number. Your ticket is #54,000,601.

By the way, we Noobosaurs love to share information. If you have any questions, I might have some good answers!

Tip: Click on characters or objects with a ! or ? floating overhead--they have information or quests for you. Many quests have special needs, such as killing monsters, finding places, or collecting objects.

For this particular quest, once you click the Accept button, you should see that two characters in Dew Valley now have quests for you: Liza Beth enthusiastically starts you on a new player tutorial, while Sir Lee hopefully wakes up enough to get you right into the action.

Turn-in:

What is that in your hand? Did you want me to take your help queue ticket from you?

Objectives:

  • Ticket #54,000,601 ×1

Level range: 1–5
